trial.offer: 🎁 Free trial for {days} Full access to every channel and feature — free, with no charges. To rule out repeated activation from several accounts, a phone number is required. Tap the button below — Telegram sends it for you. The number is not stored: only an irreversible fingerprint goes into the database. Changed your mind — send /cancel.
trial.need_button:
📱 A number from Telegram is required — text typed by hand cannot be verified.

Tap «Share phone number» or send /cancel.
trial.cancelled: Alright, the trial was not activated.
trial.cancel_hint: You can subscribe at any time.
trial.declined_hint: Access is available with a subscription.
trial.activated: 🎁 Free trial for {days} Plan: {plan} Valid until: {expires} I will remind you a day before it ends.
